The '''Kadok Regions''', also known as '''Bitthævrian space''', were the areas of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] inhabited by the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] race in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], near [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] and [[Huk/Legends|Huk]]. They never joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Tertiary Kadok system]] was in the Kadok Regions.

The Bitthævrians staged attacks against the local delegations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] in Bitthævrian space. As Kalee was a nearby target, they also attacked that [[Planet/Legends|planet]], leading to the [[Bitthævrian War]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the region was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rhain Towith]].
